meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 群组里搭起一套持久的 wiki 知识库：建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录、索引和日志文件、一份维护用的技能文件，并改写该群的 CLAUDE.md。之后你给的资料会被逐份整理进 wiki。
howto.when: 当你说出 “add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base” 等词时触发；它会先问你想把 wiki 放在哪个群组。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 它会先问你选哪个群、wiki 的主题是什么

say.text: 把这份 PDF 收进 wiki
say.note: 逐份读取、讨论要点，再更新各 wiki 页面

say.text: 每周给 wiki 做一次健康检查
say.note: 用 schedule_task 安排定期 lint

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group: it creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, index and log files, a maintenance skill, and a group CLAUDE.md section. Sources you provide are ingested one file at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base" or similar. It then asks which group should host the wiki.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: It first asks which group and what topic

say_en.text: Ingest this PDF into the wiki
say_en.note: Reads it, discusses takeaways, updates wiki pages

say_en.text: Run a weekly wiki health check
